title: Child survival gap, poorest vs richest fifth
unit: Under-5 deaths, poorest fifth ÷ richest fifth

provenance.definition: Under-five mortality among the poorest 20% of households divided by that of the richest 20%, latest survey per country. A ratio of 3 means a child in the poorest fifth is three times as likely to die before five as one in the richest fifth of the same country. A curated 11-country spread sorted descending.
provenance.attribution: DHS & UNICEF MICS, via World Bank (HNP by wealth quintile)
provenance.primarySource: Demographic and Health Surveys / UNICEF MICS

recipe.detail: latest value per country, 11 curated countries sorted descending
